subject: Co-hosted field demo + October roadshow — calendar & MDF alignment
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@cloudsynergy.io>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>, Samantha Reed <s.reed@cloudsynergy.io>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal — joint field demo + October roadshow

Hi Priya —

Great to meet you at the Summit last week. CloudSynergy is planning a regional roadshow (SF Bay Area + Sacramento, Oct 12-14) focused on developer tooling and inference at the edge. We’d love to co-host a field demo with Redwood at the SF stop and include a shared tabletop/demo area during the roadshow. High-level asks from our side:
- MDF contribution: we typically run 50/50 for co-hosted roadshows; draft T&Cs attached for reference.
- Shared registration page with co-branding and joint landing page.
- One 20-minute joint technical demo slot + 10-minute live Q&A.

Can your team confirm interest and preliminary budget alignment? If it helps, I can send expected attendance and regional attendee profiles.

Attaching: CloudSynergy_MDF_T&Cs_v1.pdf

Cheers,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Partnerships
CloudSynergy Events
liam@cloudsynergy.io
+1 415-555-0192

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@cloudsynergy.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 12:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal — joint field demo + October roadshow

Liam —

Thanks — excited by this. We’re interested in participating in SF (Oct 12) and potentially the Sacramento stop if timing/roster allows. Quick reactions and asks from Redwood: 

- MDF: Redwood typically targets 60/40 (vendor/customer split leaning toward partner covering travel/venue incidentals). That said, we are flexible with stronger co-marketing commitments (paid social, email send, and 1 webinar pre-event). Can you confirm CloudSynergy’s minimum guaranteed lead count or expected registrations?
- Registration & tracking: we need a shared registration page that maps source to HubSpot campaign + UTM params. Please confirm you can expose registration data or we’ll require CSV exports weekly.
- Booth staffing: we’ll provide 2 engineers for the demo; would expect CloudSynergy to staff at least 2 BDRs for follow-up.
- Creative & assets: Marissa, looping you to lead creative timeline. We’ll need co-branded hero and email for an initial save-the-date by mid-June.

I’ve attached a draft field-demo agenda and a rough promo assets list to scope deliverables. Let’s set a working call — availability this week?

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Sr. Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
priya@redwoodinference.com
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference runtime

Attachments: redwood_field-demo-agenda-draft.docx

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@cloudsynergy.io>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samantha Reed <s.reed@cloudsynergy.io>
Date: Tue, 31 Mar 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal — joint field demo + October roadshow

Priya —

Appreciate the quick reply. A few datapoints to clarify:
- Expected registrations: ~220 for SF; historically convert ~18-22% to qualified MQLs. We can commit to a baseline of 35 marketing-qualified leads attributed to the joint campaign, subject to the registration data we collect.
- MDF: we can do 50/50 if Redwood runs the pre-event webinar and provides the hero email send you mentioned. The attached T&Cs are editable — happy to move to a DocuSign MOU once we align terms.
- Registration sharing: we can give API access to the registration export or weekly CSV; whichever is easier for your ops team.

I’m free for a 30-minute sync Wed 11:00-11:30 PT or Thurs 14:00-14:30 PT. Which works?

Thanks,
Liam

>
> Thanks — excited by this. We’re interested in participating in SF (Oct 12) and potentially the Sacramento stop if timing/roster allows. Quick reactions and asks from Redwood: ...

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Proposal — joint field demo + October roadshow

Priya / Marissa —

I reviewed the numbers; we can be broadly supportive but prefer clarity on the measurement & protections before committing 60/40. Proposed commercial guardrails: 

- MDF ceiling: Redwood commits up to $20k (40% of $50k total MDF). Anything above will require a revenue or pipeline protection clause (e.g., minimum SQLs or a prorated reimbursement formula).
- Performance triggers: 3 customer intros or 5 product-qualified trials within 90 days to avoid clawback.
- Creative approvals: Redwood retains final approval on Red-themed assets and demo scripts referencing our product roadmap.

Marissa — please capture deliverable timelines in the shared doc. Priya — if CloudSynergy signs a DocuSign MOU with the 50/50 suggestion, we can flex to 50/50 with the performance triggers above.

Ben Carter
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
ben@redwoodinference.com

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@cloudsynergy.io>, Samantha Reed <s.reed@cloudsynergy.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal — joint field demo + October roadshow

Liam / Samantha —

Thanks for the clarification and the flexibility. To summarize and confirm next steps: 

1) MDF proposal: CloudSynergy proposes 50/50. Redwood agrees to 50/50 provided the following are included in the MOU: weekly registration exports (CSV or API), a minimum guarantee of 35 MQLs, and the performance triggers Ben outlined (3 intros or 5 trials within 90 days to avoid prorated reimbursement).

2) Creative & timing: Marissa will own the co-branded hero + email. Marissa — please share a 6-week production timeline and first draft by June 15 so we can do a save-the-date in mid-June.

3) Demo & booth ops: Redwood will provide 2 engineers for the Oct 12 SF demo and 2 BDRs for onsite follow-up. CloudSynergy to confirm booth footprint and table allocation by April 16.

4) Legal/Docs: attaching an updated T&Cs file with the agreed bullets. Liam — please review and push to DocuSign when ready. I’ve also added the HubSpot deal link HS-48271 for tracking.

Attachments: CloudSynergy_MDF_T&Cs_v1.pdf, promo_assets_v1.zip

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123-cloudsynergy-mdf
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/HS-48271

If that summary matches, I’ll ask Legal to do a quick review and then we can route to DocuSign. Please confirm by EOD Monday so we can lock the timeline.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
